name: Coffee with Prescilla
source:
A choice-driven episodic Adult Visual Novel mini-game that gets right to the point. In this episode you'll be going to a coffee shop, and meeting Prescilla for the first time!

Let's see where your choices will take you!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1383780/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
这是一款由选择推动、开门见山的分集式成人视觉小说小游戏。在这一集中，你将前往咖啡店，第一次与普莉西拉见面！

看看你的选择会将你带往何处！

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1383780/]Steam[/url]]
